PREFIX ref: <https://example.org/ref#>
SELECT ?zone ?tsid ?cls WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?pt .
  ?pt a ?cls .
  ?pt ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
} LIMIT 50

PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zoneName .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?pt .
  ?pt a ?ptClass .
  ?pt ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
} LIMIT 200

  ?pts a ?ptClass .

} LIMIT 200
